sentences.zh: 長興四年春正月戊寅朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Changxing, spring, first month, wuyin new moon: the Emperor took the Bright Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and retinue were as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the first month in spring of Changxing 4, Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Bright Hall with full ceremonial guard.

sentences.zh: 是日雪盈尺。

translations.literal: That day snow piled a full foot deep.
translations.idiomatic: Snow that day reached a foot deep.

sentences.zh: 戊子，秦王從榮加守尚書令、兼侍中，依前河南尹，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: On wuzi Prince Qin Congrong was advanced to acting Director of the Masters of Writing with concurrent Palace Attendant, remaining as before Henan Intendant, and assigned to oversee the Six Armies and various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Prince Qin Li Congrong was made acting director of the Masters of Writing and concurrent palace attendant, kept his post as Henan intendant, and placed in charge of the Six Armies and palace guards.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以端明殿學士、尚書兵部侍郎劉煦為中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: On gengyin Duanming Hall academician and Master of the Works Bureau of War Vice Minister Liu Xu was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Counsellor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Xu, duanming academician and vice war minister, joined the secretariat as vice director and associate counsellor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，正衙命使冊故福慶長公主孟氏為晉國雍順長公主，遣太常卿崔居儉赴西川行冊禮。

translations.literal: On jiawu in the main court audience messengers were commissioned to enfeoff the late Lady of Lengthy Fortune, the Princess Consort Lady Meng, as Grand Princess of Supreme Compliance of Jin state; Grand Minister of Ceremonies Cui Jujian was sent to the western circuits to perform the enfeoffment rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Mingzong named messengers in formal court to ennoble the late Princess Meng of Fuqing as Grand Princess of Yongshun in Jin; Cui Jujian, grand minister of ceremonies, went to Sichuan to conduct the rite.

sentences.zh: 突厥內附。

translations.literal: The Turks submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: Turkic peoples submitted to the court.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以前河東節度使李從溫為鄆州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi former Hedong military commissioner Li Congwen was made Yanzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi former Hedong commissioner Li Congwen became Yanzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑朔，帝於便殿問範延光內外見管馬數，對曰：「三萬五千匹。

translations.literal: Second month, guichou new moon: at the side hall the Emperor asked Fan Yanguang the number of horses under management inside and outside; he replied: "Thirty-five thousand head."
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon in the second month Mingzong asked Fan Yanguang in the side hall how many horses the state maintained; Fan answered, "Thirty-five thousand."

sentences.zh: 」帝歎曰：「太祖在太願，騎軍不過七千，先皇自始至終馬才及萬。

translations.literal: The Emperor sighed and said: "When the Founder was at Taiyuan, cavalry did not exceed seven thousand; from start to finish the Former Emperor's horses barely reached ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong sighed and said, "At Taiyuan our Founder had fewer than seven thousand horsemen; my brother Zhuangzong never mustered more than ten thousand mounts in his entire reign.

sentences.zh: 今有鐵馬如是，而不能使九州混一，是吾養士練將之不至也。

translations.literal: Now with iron horses thus many, yet unable to unite the Nine Provinces—this is my failure to nurture men and train generals adequately.
translations.idiomatic: Yet we keep a host of war-horses like this and still cannot reunite the realm—that means we have failed to train officers and soldiers properly."

sentences.zh: 吾老矣，馬將奈何！

translations.literal: I am old; what is to become of the horses!
translations.idiomatic: I am old; what will become of all these horses?

sentences.zh: 」延光奏曰：「臣每思之，國家養馬太多，試計一騎士之費，可贍步軍五人，三萬五千騎抵十五萬步軍，既無所施，虛耗國力，臣恐日久難繼。

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang memorialized: "Your servant often reflects on this—the state maintains too many horses. Calculate one cavalryman's cost and it could supply five foot soldiers; thirty-five thousand mounts equal one hundred fifty thousand foot soldiers, yet there is nowhere to employ them, empty wastage of national strength; your servant fears that in time this will be hard to sustain."
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang said, "I have long thought the state keeps too many horses. One cavalryman's upkeep would feed five infantrymen; thirty-five thousand riders equal a hundred fifty thousand foot soldiers we have no use for. The waste will drain the treasury, and I fear we cannot keep it up indefinitely."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「誠如卿言，肥騎士而瘠吾民，何益哉！」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Truly as you say—fattening knights while emaciating our people, what benefit is there!"
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said, "You are right. We fatten horsemen while our people go thin—what good does that do?"

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Bracket note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：上問見管馬數，樞密使範延光奏：「天下常支草粟者近五萬匹。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: When the Emperor asked the number of horses under management, Commissioner of Military Affairs Fan Yanguang memorialized: "Those regularly receiving fodder and grain nationwide number nearly fifty thousand head.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials: When the emperor asked about state horses, Fan Yanguang of the Military Affairs Commission reported, "Nearly fifty thousand mounts receive regular fodder pay nationwide.

sentences.zh: 見今西北諸道蕃賣馬者往來如市，其郵傳之費、中估之直，日以四十五貫，以臣計之，國力十耗其七，馬無所使，財賦漸消，朝廷甚非所利。

translations.literal: Currently along the northwestern circuits foreign traders selling horses come and go like a marketplace; courier costs and appraisal value amount to forty-five thousand cash per day; by your servant's reckoning, national strength is seven-tenths depleted, horses have no use, revenues gradually dissipate—this is greatly not to the court's advantage.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign horse dealers now crowd the northwest like a market; relay costs and appraisal fees run forty-five thousand cash a day. By my reckoning we are losing seven-tenths of our strength on horses we cannot use, revenues are melting away, and the court gains nothing from it.

sentences.zh: 」上善之。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，敕沿邊藩鎮，或有蕃部賣馬，可擇其良壯給券，具數以聞。）〉

translations.literal: Tenth month: an edict to frontier military commissioners that if foreign tribes sell horses, they may select sturdy ones and issue certificates, reporting the number fully.)〉
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month an edict told frontier commanders that when tribes offered horses they should pick sound animals, issue vouchers, and report the totals.)〉

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以虔州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中馬希振為洪州節度使；

translations.literal: On dingsi Qianzhou military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Xizhen was made Hongzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Ma Xizhen of Qianzhou, acting grand mentor and palace attendant, became Hongzhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以鄂州節度使馬希廣為檢校太尉、同平章事，充桂州節度使；

translations.literal: Ezhou military commissioner Ma Xiguang was made Acting Grand Mentor and Associate Counsellor, filling Guizhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xiguang of Ezhou was made acting grand mentor and associate counsellor and sent to Guizhou;

sentences.zh: 以盧州節度使兼武安軍副使姚彥章為檢校太尉、同平章事；

translations.literal: Luzhou military commissioner and concurrent Wu'an Army deputy regent Yao Yanchang was made Acting Grand Mentor and Associate Counsellor;
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yanchang of Luzhou, also Wu'an deputy regent, was made acting grand mentor and associate counsellor;

sentences.zh: 以靜江節度副使馬希範為鄂州節度使。

translations.literal: Jingjiang military deputy regent Ma Xifan was made Ezhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xifan, Jingjiang deputy, became Ezhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 故潞州節度使、檢校太保康君立贈太傅。

translations.literal: The late Luzhou military commissioner, Acting Grand Guardian Kang Junli was posthumously granted Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: The late Luzhou commissioner Kang Junli was posthumously made grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 己未，宋州節度使安元信加兼侍中。

translations.literal: On jiwei Songzhou military commissioner An Yuanxin was advanced to concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei An Yuanxin of Songzhou was also made palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 濮州進重修河堤圖，沿河地名，曆曆可數。

translations.literal: Puzhou presented a revised map of river dikes; place names along the river could be counted one by one.
translations.idiomatic: Puzhou submitted a revised map of Yellow River levees with every place name along the banks marked.

sentences.zh: 帝覽之，愀然曰：「吾佐先朝定天下，於此堤塢間小大數百戰。

translations.literal: The Emperor perused it and said somberly: "I aided the Former Court in settling the realm; along these dikes and ramparts I fought hundreds of battles large and small.
translations.idiomatic: Reading it, Mingzong said gravely, "I helped the previous reign conquer the realm and fought hundreds of battles along these levees and forts.

sentences.zh: 」又指一邱曰：「此吾擐甲台也。

translations.literal: He also pointed to a mound and said: "This is the terrace where I donned armor.
translations.idiomatic: He pointed to a hill and said, "That is where I buckled on my armor.

sentences.zh: 時事如昨，奄忽一紀，令人悲歎耳！

translations.literal: Events like yesterday, yet in a flash twelve years have passed—how it stirs grief and sighing!
translations.idiomatic: It feels like yesterday, yet twelve years have rushed by—how sad!"

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以西川節度使孟知祥為劍南東、西兩川節度使，封蜀王。

translations.literal: On guihai western-circuit military commissioner Meng Zhixiang was made military commissioner of both eastern and western Jiannan circuits and enfeoffed Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Meng Zhixiang of the western circuits received both Jiannan commands and was enfeoffed Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 三司奏：「當省有諸道鹽鐵轉運使衙職員都押衙、正押衙、同押衙、通引、衙前虞候、子弟，今欲列為三司職名。

translations.literal: The Three Departments memorialized: "This ministry has salt-and-iron transport commissioners' yamen staff titles—chief military escort, chief escort, associate escort, guide, yamen front guard, and retainers—now wishing to list them as Three Departments position titles.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments asked to register transport commissioners' staff titles—chief escort, escort, associate escort, guide, guards, and retainers—as formal Three Departments posts.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以御史中丞崔衍為兵部侍郎，以右諫議大夫龍敏為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On gengwu Censor-in-Chief Cui Yan was made Vice Minister of War; Right Reminder Long Min was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Cui Yan became vice war minister; Long Min became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，幸龍門。

translations.literal: Third month, jimao: the Emperor visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the third month Mingzong visited Longmen.

sentences.zh: 延州節度使安從進奏，夏州節度使李仁福卒，其子彝超自稱留後。

translations.literal: Yanzhou military commissioner An Congjin memorialized that Xiazhou military commissioner Li Renfu had died and his son Yichao had declared himself acting regent.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin of Yan reported that Li Renfu of Xia had died and his son Yichao had proclaimed himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，鎮州奏，行軍司馬趙瑰、節度判官陸浣、元從押衙高知柔等並棄市，坐受賂枉法殺人也。

translations.literal: On jiashen Zhenzhou memorialized that campaign deputy marshal Zhao Gui, military commissioner adjutant Lu Huan, original follower chief escort Gao Zhirou, and others were all executed in the marketplace for taking bribes and perverting the law to kill people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhen reported that deputy marshal Zhao Gui, adjutant Lu Huan, escort Gao Zhirou, and others were executed for bribery and wrongful execution.

sentences.zh: 節度使李從敏罰一季俸。

translations.literal: Military commissioner Li Congmin was fined one season's salary.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Li Congmin was fined one quarter's pay.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以西川節度副使、知武泰軍節度兵馬留後趙季良為檢校太保、黔南節度使；

translations.literal: On yiyou western-circuit military deputy regent and acting Wutai Army military regent Zhao Jiliang was made Acting Grand Guardian and Qiannan military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zhao Jiliang, Sichuan deputy and Wutai regent, became acting grand guardian and Qiannan commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以西川諸軍馬步都指揮使、知武信軍節度兵馬留後李仁罕為檢校太傅、遂州節度使；

translations.literal: Western-circuit combined horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Wuxin Army military regent Li Renhan was made Acting Grand Tutor and Suizhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Renhan, Sichuan commander and Wuxin regent, became acting grand tutor and Suizhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以西川左廂馬步指揮使、知保寧軍節度兵馬留後趙廷隱為檢校太保、閬州節度使；

translations.literal: Western-circuit left wing horse-and-foot commander and acting Baoning Army military regent Zhao Tingyin was made Acting Grand Guardian and Langzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Tingyin, left-wing commander and Baoning regent, became acting grand guardian and Lang commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以西川右廂馬步都指揮使、知寧江軍兵馬留後張知業為檢校司徒、夔州節度使；

translations.literal: Western-circuit right wing horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Ningjiang Army military regent Zhang Zhiye was made Acting Director of Works and Kuizhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhiye, right-wing commander and Ningjiang regent, became acting director of works and Kuizhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以西川衙內馬步都指揮使、知昭武軍兵馬留後李肇為檢校太保、利州節度使，從孟知祥之請也。

translations.literal: Western-circuit inner horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Zhaowu Army military regent Li Zhao was made Acting Grand Guardian and Lizhou military commissioner, at Meng Zhixiang's request.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao, inner commander and Zhaowu regent, became acting grand guardian and Lizhou commissioner at Meng Zhixiang's request.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜宰相李愚絹百匹、錢十萬、鋪陳物一十三件。

translations.literal: On bingxu Chancellor Li Yu was granted one hundred bolts of silk, one hundred thousand cash, and thirteen items of bedding furnishings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the ailing chancellor Li Yu received a hundred bolts of silk, a hundred thousand cash, and thirteen bedding sets.

sentences.zh: 時愚病，帝令近臣翟光鄴宣問，所居寢室，蕭然四壁，病榻弊氈而已。

translations.literal: At the time Yu was ill; the Emperor ordered a close attendant, Zhai Guangye, to convey inquiries; his dwelling had bare walls on all sides, a sick couch with worn felt—that was all.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu was ill; Mingzong sent Zhai Guangye to inquire after him and learned his home had bare walls and only a sickbed with a threadbare rug.

sentences.zh: 光鄴具言其事，故有是賜。

translations.literal: Guangye reported the matter fully; hence this grant.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai reported this, which led to the gift.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以延州節度使安從進為夏州留後，以夏州左都押衙、四州防遏使李彝超為延州留後，仍命邠州節度使藥彥稠、宮苑使安重益帥師援送從進赴鎮。

translations.literal: On wuzi Yanzhou military commissioner An Congjin was made Xiazhou acting regent; Xiazhou left chief escort and four-circuit defense commissioner Li Yichao was made Yanzhou acting regent; still ordered Binzhou military commissioner Yao Yanchou and palace commissioner An Chongyi to lead troops escorting Congjin to his post.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi An Congjin of Yan became Xia acting commissioner; Li Yichao, Xia's left chief escort, became Yan acting commissioner; Yao Yanchou of Bin and palace commissioner An Chongyi were ordered to escort An Congjin to his post.

sentences.zh: 以左衛上將軍盧文進為潞州節度使，以右龍武統軍張溫為雲州節度使。

translations.literal: Left Guard senior general Lu Wenjin was made Luzhou military commissioner; Right Martial Valiant supreme general Zhang Wen was made Yunzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wenjin, left guard senior general, became Luzhou commissioner; Zhang Wen, right martial valiant supreme general, became Yunzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以鳳翔行軍司馬李彥琮為鹽州防禦使。

translations.literal: On gengyin Fengxiang campaign deputy marshal Li Yancong was made Yazhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Yancong, Fengxiang deputy marshal, became Yazhou defender.

sentences.zh: 時範延光等奏，請因夏州之師製置鹽州，故有是命。

translations.literal: At the time Fan Yanguang and others memorialized requesting that in connection with the Xiazhou campaign arrangements be made for Yazhou; hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang and others had asked to establish Yazhou defenses during the Xia campaign, hence the appointment.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以右威衛上將軍安重霸為同州節度使。

translations.literal: On guisi Right Majestic Guard senior general An Chongba was made Tongzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi An Chongba, right majestic guard senior general, became Tongzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以左龍武統軍符彥超為安州節度使。

translations.literal: On jihai Left Martial Valiant supreme general Fu Yanchao was made Anzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Fu Yanchao, left martial valiant supreme general, became Anzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔除放京兆、秦、岐、邠、涇、延、慶、同、華、興元十州長興元年二年係欠夏秋稅物，及營田莊宅務課利，以其曾輦運供軍糧料也。

translations.literal: An edict remitted summer-and-autumn tax arrears from Changxing 1 and 2 owed by the ten prefectures Jingzhao, Qin, Qi, Bin, Jing, Yan, Qing, Tong, Hua, and Xingyuan, and estate-field and manor-office levies, because they had transported grain for the army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict canceled summer and autumn tax arrears from Changxing 1–2 for Jingzhao, Qin, Qi, Bin, Jing, Yan, Qing, Tong, Hua, and Xingyuan, plus estate levies, because those regions had hauled army grain.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，故晉國夫人夏氏追冊皇后，有司上諡曰昭懿，從之。

translations.literal: On jiachen the late Lady of Jin state Lady Xia was posthumously enfeoffed empress; the relevant offices proposed the posthumous title Zhaoyi; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the late Lady Xia of Jin was posthumously made empress with the temple name Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，李彝超奏：「奉詔除延州留後，已受恩命訖，三軍百姓擁隔，未遂赴任。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wushen: Li Yichao memorialized: "Having received the edict removing me as Yanzhou acting regent, I have already accepted the gracious appointment; yet the three armies and the people block the way, and I cannot proceed to my post.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the fourth month Li Yichao reported, "I have accepted appointment as Yan acting commissioner, but troops and civilians block my departure.

sentences.zh: 」帝遣閣門使蘇繼顏齎詔促彝超赴任。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent Palace Gate Commissioner Su Jiyan bearing an edict urging Yichao to proceed to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong sent Su Jiyan of the palace gate office with an edict ordering Yichao to take up his post.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以刑部侍郎劉讚為秘書監、秦王傅。

translations.literal: On guichou Vice Minister of Punishments Liu Zan was made Director of the Palace Library and Prince of Qin tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Zan, vice punishments minister, became palace librarian and tutor to the Prince of Qin.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Bracket note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：長興四年四月，以秘書監劉讚為秦王傅，前忠武軍節度判官蘇瓚為秦王友，前襄州觀察使魚崇遠為秦王府記室參軍。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Fourth month of Changxing 4, Director of the Palace Library Liu Zan was made Prince of Qin tutor; former Zhongwu Army military commissioner adjutant Su Zan was made Prince of Qin companion; former Xiangzhou observation commissioner Yu Chongyuan was made Prince of Qin secretariat recorder.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials: In the fourth month of Changxing 4 Liu Zan became Prince of Qin tutor; Su Zan, former Zhongwu adjutant, became his companion; Yu Chongyuan, former Xiang observer, became secretariat recorder.

sentences.zh: 時言事者請為秦王置師傅，上顧問近臣，皆以秦王名勢隆盛，不敢置議，請自選擇，乃降是命。）〉

translations.literal: At the time memorializers requested tutors and companions for the Prince of Qin; the Emperor looked to close ministers, who all said the prince's name and power were too great to dare discuss appointments and asked him to choose himself; hence this decree.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Memorialists had asked to staff the prince's household; close ministers said his stature was too great for them to name tutors, so the emperor chose the appointees himself.)〉

sentences.zh: 甲寅，前鄧州節度使梁漢顒以太子少師致仕，太子賓客裴皞以兵部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On jiayin former Dengzhou military commissioner Liang Hanyong retired as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Crown Prince Guest Pei Hao retired as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Liang Hanyong, former Deng commissioner, retired as junior heir-apparent tutor; Pei Hao, crown prince guest, retired as war minister.

sentences.zh: 戊午，追冊昭宗皇后何氏為宣穆皇后，祔饗太廟，百僚進名奉慰，廢朝三日。

translations.literal: On wuwu posthumously enfeoffed Empress He of Emperor Zhaozong as Empress Xuanmu, with spirit tablet in the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the hundred officials advanced names in condolence; court audience was suspended three days.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Empress He of Zhaozong was posthumously enshrined as Empress Xuanmu in the ancestral temple; officials offered condolences and court was suspended three days.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以左散騎常侍任讚為戶部侍郎，以吏部侍郎藥縱之為曹州刺史。

translations.literal: On jisi Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Ren Zan was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Vice Minister of Personnel Yao Zongzhi was made Caozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Ren Zan became vice revenue minister; Yao Zongzhi, vice personnel minister, became Caozhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，延州奏，蕃部劫掠餉運及攻城之具，守蘆關兵士退守金明鎮。

translations.literal: On guiyou Yanzhou memorialized that foreign tribes had raided supply convoys and siege equipment; troops guarding Luguan retreated to defend Jinming Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Yan reported tribal raids on convoys and siege gear; Luguan garrison fell back to Jinming Fort.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子朔，帝御文明殿受朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingzi new moon: the Emperor took the Hall of Civilization to receive court audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon in the fifth month Mingzong held court at the Hall of Civilization.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇子鳳翔節度使從珂封潞王。

translations.literal: On wuyin the prince, Fengxiang military commissioner Congke, was enfeoffed Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Prince Li Congke of Fengxiang was enfeoffed Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 新授戶部侍郎任讚改刑部侍郎，讚訴以所授官是丁憂闕，故改正。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Vice Minister of Revenue Ren Zan was changed to Vice Minister of Punishments; Zan complained that the office granted was one left vacant by mourning.
translations.idiomatic: New vice revenue minister Ren Zan was reassigned to vice punishments minister because the revenue post had been a mourning vacancy.

sentences.zh: 皇子從益封許王，鄆州節度使李從溫封兗王，河中節度使李從璋封洋王，鎮州節度使李從敏封涇王。

translations.literal: Prince Congyi was enfeoffed Prince of Xu; Yanzhou military commissioner Li Congwen Prince of Yan; Hezhong military commissioner Li Congzhang Prince of Yang; Zhenzhou military commissioner Li Congmin Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Congyi became Prince of Xu; Li Congwen of Yan became Prince of Yan; Li Congzhang of Hezhong became Prince of Yang; Li Congmin of Zhen became Prince of Jing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，帝避暑於九曲池，既而登樓，風毒暴作，聖體不豫，翌日而愈。

translations.literal: On jiashen the Emperor took the summer heat at the Nine-Bend Pool; afterward he ascended a tower; a violent wind toxin struck; the sacred person was unwell; the next day he recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Mingzong sought cool air at the Nine-Bend Pool, then climbed a tower; a sudden wind illness seized him, but he was better the next day.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Bracket note

sentences.zh: （《北夢瑣言》云：上聖體乖和，馮道對寢膳之間，動思調衛，因指御前果實曰：「如食桃不康，翌日見李而思戒可也。

translations.literal: (The 《Trivial Tales of Northern Dreams》 says: When the Emperor's sacred person was indisposed, Feng Dao in the sleeping-quarters meals reflected on regimen and pointed to fruit before the throne, saying: "If eating peaches is harmful, the next day upon seeing plums one may think to abstain.
translations.idiomatic: (From Northern Dreams: When Mingzong fell ill, Feng Dao at his bedside spoke of diet and pointed to fruit, saying, "If peaches harm you, seeing plums the next day should remind you to abstain.

sentences.zh: 」初，上因禦李，暴得風虛之疾，馮道不敢斥言，因奏事諷悟上意。）〉

translations.literal: Initially the Emperor because of eating plums at court suddenly contracted wind-deficiency illness; Feng Dao dared not speak bluntly and so in memorializing affairs hinted to awaken the Emperor's mind.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong had fallen ill after eating plums in court; Feng Dao dared not rebuke him directly and used memorial business to hint at restraint.)〉

sentences.zh: 丙戌，契丹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Khitan sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Khitan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，安從進奏，大軍已至夏州，攻城，以其不受命也。

translations.literal: On dingyou An Congjin memorialized that the great army had reached Xiazhou and was besieging the city because it would not accept orders.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou An Congjin reported the main force at Xiazhou besieging the city for defying orders.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以靈武留後張希崇為本州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi Lingwu acting regent Zhang Xichong was made military commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Zhang Xichong, Lingwu acting regent, became full commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，故夏州節度使、朔方郡王李仁福追封虢王。

translations.literal: On xinchou the late Xiazhou military commissioner, Prince of Shuofang Li Renfu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Guo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the late Li Renfu of Xia, prince of Shuofang, was posthumously made Prince of Guo.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以前晉州留後薄文為本州節度使。

translations.literal: On renyin former Jinzhou acting regent Bo Wen was made military commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Bo Wen, former Jin acting regent, became Jin commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午朔，文武百僚、宰臣馮道等拜章，請於尊號內加「廣運法天」四字，凡拜三章，詔允之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingwu new moon: civil and military officials of the hundred offices and Chancellor Feng Dao and others submitted memorials requesting that within the honorific title the four characters "Broad Fortune Aligning with Heaven" be added; in all they submitted three times; an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon in the sixth month officials led by Feng Dao three times asked to add "Broad Fortune Aligning with Heaven" to Mingzong's honorific; the edict approved.

sentences.zh: 詔宮西新園宜名永芳園，其間新殿宜名和慶殿。

translations.literal: An edict: the new garden west of the palace should be named Ever-Fragrant Garden; the new hall within it should be named Harmonious Celebration Hall.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named the new western garden Ever-Fragrant Garden and its new hall Harmonious Celebration Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，秦王從榮加食邑至萬戶，實封二千戶。

translations.literal: On bingchen Prince of Qin Congrong's fief was increased to ten thousand households, with two thousand actual enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Prince of Qin Congrong's nominal fief rose to ten thousand households with two thousand actual.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以右驍衛上將軍李從昶為左龍武統軍，以前邢州節度使高允韜為右龍武統軍，以右驍衛上將軍羅周敬為左羽林統軍，以右監門上將軍婁繼英為金州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingsi Right Martial Steed senior general Li Congchang was made Left Martial Valiant supreme general; former Xingzhou military commissioner Gao Yuntao was made Right Martial Valiant supreme general; Right Martial Steed senior general Luo Zhoujing was made Left Forest Guard supreme general; Right Gate Guard senior general Lou Jiying was made Jinzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Congchang became left martial valiant supreme general; Gao Yuntao, former Xing commissioner, right martial valiant supreme general; Luo Zhoujing left forest guard supreme general; Lou Jiying became Jin prefect.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宋王從厚加食邑至萬戶，實封一千戶。

translations.literal: On wuwu Prince of Song Conghou's fief was increased to ten thousand households, with one thousand actual enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Prince of Song Conghou's nominal fief rose to ten thousand households with one thousand actual.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以前涇州節度使李金全為滄州節度使。

translations.literal: On renxu former Jingzhou military commissioner Li Jinquan was made Cangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Jinquan, former Jing commissioner, became Cangzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔御史中丞龍敏等詳定《大中統類》。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict ordered Censor-in-Chief Long Min and others to compile in detail the 《Comprehensive Categories of the Dazhong Era》.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict told Long Min and others to compile the Comprehensive Categories of the Dazhong era.

sentences.zh: 甲子，第十四女封壽安公主，第十五女封永樂公主。

translations.literal: On jiazi the fourteenth daughter was enfeoffed Princess of Shou'an; the fifteenth daughter Princess of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the fourteenth daughter became Princess of Shou'an and the fifteenth Princess of Yongle.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前利州節度使孫漢韶為洋州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen former Lizhou military commissioner Sun Hanshao was made Yangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Sun Hanshao, former Li commissioner, became Yang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，永寧軍節度使、容州管內觀察使、檢校太尉、兼侍中馬存加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On renshen Yongning Army military commissioner, Rongzhou circuit observation commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Cun received increased fief and actual enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Ma Cun of Yongning and Rong, acting grand mentor and palace attendant, received added nominal and actual fief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，帝復不豫。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Emperor was again unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Mingzong fell ill again.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，以著作佐郎尹拙為左拾遺，直史館。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingchou: Editorial Assistant Yin Zhuo was made Left Reminder with concurrent duty in the History Office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the seventh month Yin Zhuo, editorial assistant, became left reminder with concurrent history office duty.

sentences.zh: 國朝舊制，皆以畿赤尉直史館，今用諫官自拙始，從監修李愚奏也。

translations.literal: The dynasty's old rule always used capital and red-uniform county magistrates for the History Office; now using a remonstrance official began with Zhuo, following supervising compiler Li Yu's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Capital magistrates had always staffed the history office; using a remonstrance official began with Yin Zhuo at Li Yu's request.

sentences.zh: 己卯，東嶽三郎神贈威雄大將軍。

translations.literal: On jimao the Third Son Spirit of Mount Tai was posthumously granted Mighty Hero Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Third Son Spirit of Mount Tai received the posthumous rank Mighty Hero Grand General.

sentences.zh: 初，帝不豫，前淄州刺史劉遂清薦泰山僧一人，雲善醫，及召見，乃庸僧耳。

translations.literal: Initially when the Emperor was unwell, former Zibo prefect Liu Suiqing recommended a Mount Tai monk, saying he was skilled in medicine; when summoned for audience, he was merely a mediocre monk.
translations.idiomatic: While Mingzong was ill, former Zibo prefect Liu Suiqing recommended a Taishan monk as a physician; when summoned, he was an ordinary monk.

sentences.zh: 問方藥，僧曰：「不工醫，嘗於泰山中親睹嶽神，謂僧曰：『吾第三子威靈可愛，而未有爵秩，師為我請之。

translations.literal: Asked about prescriptions, the monk said: "I am not skilled in medicine; once on Mount Tai I personally beheld the mountain god, who told the monk: 'My third son's awesome spirit is lovable, yet he has no rank and stipend—Master, please request them for me.'
translations.idiomatic: Asked for medicine, the monk said he was no doctor but had seen the mountain god on Taishan, who asked him to seek rank for a beloved third son who had none.

sentences.zh: 』」宮中神其事，故有是命，識者嫉遂清之妖佞焉。

translations.literal: The palace treated the matter as miraculous; hence this decree; the knowing resented Suiqing's sorcerous flattery.
translations.idiomatic: The palace treated this as divine, hence the decree; critics despised Liu Suiqing's sorcery and flattery.

sentences.zh: 詔應台官出行，須令人訶引，使軍巡職掌等規避。

translations.literal: An edict: when censorial officials go out, they must have persons to shout and lead the way, making army patrol officers and the like give way.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required censors on the street to be heralded so patrol troops would clear the way.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔安從進班師，時王師攻夏州無功故也。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict ordered An Congjin to withdraw the army, because the imperial army's attack on Xiazhou had achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict recalled An Congjin because the Xia campaign had failed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以許州節度使孟鵠卒廢朝，贈太傅。

translations.literal: On yiyou Xuzhou military commissioner Meng Gu died; court audience was suspended; he was posthumously granted Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Meng Gu of Xu died; court mourned him and he was posthumously made grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 詔賜在京諸軍將校優給有差。

translations.literal: An edict granted differentiated generous allowances to generals and officers of the various armies in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict gave graded bonuses to capital army officers.

sentences.zh: 時帝疾未痊，軍士有流言故也。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor's illness had not yet healed; there was loose talk among the soldiers; hence this.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong was still ill and soldiers were spreading rumors, hence the bonuses.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，兩浙節度使、檢校太傅、守中書令錢元瓘封吳王。

translations.literal: On dinghai the two Zhe military commissioner, Acting Grand Tutor and acting Director of the Secretariat Qian Yuanguan was enfeoffed Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Qian Yuanguan of the two Zhe circuits, acting grand tutor and secretariat director, was enfeoffed Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，帝被袞冕，禦明堂殿受冊，徽號曰聖明神武廣運法天文德恭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wushen: the Emperor donned ceremonial robes and took the Bright Hall to receive enfeoffment; the honorific was Sagely, Bright, Divine, Martial, Broad Fortune, Aligning with Heaven, Cultured in Virtue, and Reverent in Filial Piety Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the eighth month Mingzong wore full regalia at the Bright Hall for his enfeoffment as Sagely, Bright, Divine, Martial, Broad Fortune, Aligning with Heaven, Cultured in Virtue, and Reverent in Filial Piety Emperor.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，製大赦天下，常赦所不原者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, he decreed a great amnesty for the realm; those normally not pardoned by regular amnesties were all pardoned and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: After the rite he proclaimed a great amnesty extending even to crimes ordinary amnesties never covered.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜侍衛諸軍優給有差。

translations.literal: On jiyou differentiated generous allowances were granted to the various palace guard armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the palace guard armies received graded bonuses.

sentences.zh: 時月內再有頒給，自茲府藏無餘積矣。

translations.literal: At the time within the month there were again distributions; from this the treasury had no surplus.
translations.idiomatic: Another payout that month emptied the treasury reserves.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以晉州節度使薄文卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On xinhai Jinzhou military commissioner Bo Wen died; court audience was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Bo Wen of Jin died; court mourned him.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以右龍武統軍李從昶為許州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingsi Right Martial Valiant supreme general Li Congchang was made Xuzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Congchang, right martial valiant supreme general, became Xuzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以秘書監高輅卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On wuwu Director of the Palace Library Gao Lüe died; court audience was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu palace librarian Gao Lüe died; court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太子太師致仕符習卒廢朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: On xinyou retired Grand Tutor Fu Xi died; court audience was suspended; he was posthumously granted Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Fu Xi, retired grand tutor, died; court mourned him and he was posthumously made grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，秦王從榮以本官充天下兵馬大元帥，加食邑萬戶，實封三千戶；

translations.literal: On xinwei Prince of Qin Congrong in his existing office filled Grand Marshal of All Forces Under Heaven; his fief was increased by ten thousand households, with three thousand actual enfeoffment;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Prince of Qin Congrong became grand marshal of all forces under heaven with an added ten-thousand-household fief and three thousand actual;

sentences.zh: 以右羽林統軍翟璋為晉州節度使；

translations.literal: Right Forest Guard supreme general Zhai Zhang was made Jinzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Zhang, right forest guard supreme general, became Jin commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以太子賓客馬鎬為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Guest Ma Hao was made Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Hao, crown prince guest, became vice revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On renshen the Emperor visited the Palace of Supreme Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Mingzong visited the Palace of Supreme Virtue.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，以戶部尚書李鈴為兵部尚書，以前戶部尚書韓彥惲為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiaxu: Minister of Revenue Li Ling was made Minister of War; former Minister of Revenue Han Yanhun was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiaxu Li Ling became war minister and former revenue minister Han Yanhun became revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Emperor visited the Palace of Supreme Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Mingzong visited the Palace of Supreme Virtue.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，樞密使範延光、趙延壽並加兼侍中，依前充使。

translations.literal: On wuyin Commissioners of Military Affairs Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou were both advanced to concurrent Palace Attendant, continuing as before in their commissions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou of the Military Affairs Commission were also made palace attendants while keeping their posts.

sentences.zh: 中書奏：「元帥儀注，諸道節度使以下帶兵權者，階下具軍禮參見；

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "For the grand marshal's protocol, military commissioners below who hold troop authority shall below the steps perform military rites in audience;
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat proposed grand-marshal protocol: commissioners with troop authority would salute with military rites below the steps;

sentences.zh: 其帶使相者，初見亦展一度公禮。

translations.literal: Those who hold commissioner and counsellor rank, at first audience also perform one round of public rites.
translations.idiomatic: those with commissioner and counsellor rank would also perform one round of public rites at first audience.

sentences.zh: 天下軍務公事，元帥府行帖指揮，其判六軍諸衛事則公牒往來，其官屬軍職，委元帥府奏請。

translations.literal: Public affairs of military affairs under heaven—the grand marshal's office issues posted orders and commands; matters of judging the Six Armies and various guards go by official memoranda back and forth; their staff military posts are entrusted to the grand marshal's office to memorialize and request.
translations.idiomatic: Military business would be directed by posted orders from the marshal's office; Six Armies and guard matters by official memoranda; staff appointments would be submitted through the marshal's office.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以兵部侍郎盧詹為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On guwei Vice Minister of War Lu Zhan was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On guwei Lu Zhan became vice personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，宰臣馮道加左僕射，李愚加吏部尚書，劉煦加刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On bingxu Chancellor Feng Dao was advanced to Left Vice Director; Li Yu to Minister of Personnel; Liu Xu to Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Feng Dao became left vice director; Li Yu personnel minister; Liu Xu punishments minister.

sentences.zh: 戊子，河陽節度使兼侍衛親軍都指揮使康義誠、山南西道節度使檢校太傅張虔釗並加同平章事。

translations.literal: On wuzi Hedong military commissioner and concurrent Personal Guard Army commander-in-chief Kang Yicheng and southern Shannan western-circuit military commissioner Acting Grand Tutor Zhang Qianzhao were both made Associate Counsellors.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Kang Yicheng of Hedong, also personal guard commander, and Zhang Qianzhao of southern Shannan west, acting grand tutor, became associate counsellors.

sentences.zh: 宣徽南院使、判三司馮贇依前檢校太傅、同中書門下二品，充三司使。

translations.literal: Southern Court of the Palace Directorate commissioner and acting Three Departments Feng Yun, as before Acting Grand Tutor and Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, filled Three Departments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yun, southern palace directorate commissioner and acting Three Departments head, kept acting grand tutor and second secretariat rank as Three Departments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 贇亡父名章，故改平章事為同二品。

translations.literal: Yun's deceased father's name was Zhang, so Associate Counsellor was changed to Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yun's late father was named Zhang, so "associate counsellor" was changed to "second rank" to avoid the taboo.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，永寧公主石氏進封魏國公主，興平公主趙氏進封齊國公主；

translations.literal: On renxu Princess of Yongning Lady Shi was advanced to Princess of Wei state; Princess of Xingping Lady Zhao was advanced to Princess of Qi state;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Princess Yongning Lady Shi became Princess of Wei and Princess Xingping Lady Zhao became Princess of Qi;

sentences.zh: 皇孫重光、重哲並授銀青光祿大夫、檢校工部尚書，秦王、宋王子也。

translations.literal: Imperial grandsons Chongguang and Chongzhe were both granted Silver-Gleam Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Acting Master of the Works Bureau; sons of the Prince of Qin and Prince of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Grandsons Chongguang and Chongzhe, sons of the Princes of Qin and Song, received silver-gleam grand master and acting works minister.

sentences.zh: 前洋州節度使梁漢顒以太子少傅致仕。

translations.literal: Former Yangzhou military commissioner Liang Hanyong retired as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Former Yang commissioner Liang Hanyong retired as junior heir-apparent tutor.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以右龍武統軍高允韜為滑州節度使，以韶州刺史、檢校司空王萬榮為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingyou Right Martial Valiant supreme general Gao Yuntao was made Huazhou military commissioner; Shaozhou prefect and Acting Director of Works Wang Wanrong was made Huazhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Gao Yuntao became Hua commissioner; Wang Wanrong, Shaozhou prefect and acting director of works, also became Hua commissioner.

sentences.zh: 萬榮，王妃之父也。

translations.literal: Wanrong was the queen consort's father.
translations.idiomatic: Wanrong was the empress's father.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以樞密使趙延壽為汴州節度使，以襄州節度使朱宏昭為檢校太尉、同平章事，充樞密使。

translations.literal: On wuxu Commissioner of Military Affairs Zhao Yanshou was made Bianzhou military commissioner; Xiangzhou military commissioner Zhu Hongzhao was made Acting Grand Mentor, Associate Counsellor, and filling Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhao Yanshou became Bian commissioner; Zhu Hongzhao of Xiang became acting grand mentor, associate counsellor, and military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時範延光、趙延壽相繼辭退樞密務，及朱宏昭有樞密之命，又麵辭訴，帝叱之曰：「爾輩皆欲離朕左右，怕在眼前，素養爾輩，將何用也！

translations.literal: At the time Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou successively declined military affairs duties; when Zhu Hongzhao received the military affairs appointment, he again faced the throne to decline and plead; the Emperor rebuked them, saying: "You all wish to leave my side, fearing before my eyes—yet I have nurtured you all along; what use are you!
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou had resigned from military affairs; when Zhu Hongzhao was named and pleaded to decline, Mingzong snapped, "You all want to leave my side because you fear me—after all I have done for you, what good are you!

sentences.zh: 」宏昭退謝，不復敢言。

translations.literal: Hongzhao withdrew and apologized, no longer daring to speak.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhao withdrew in apology and said no more.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎張文寶卒。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Zhang Wenbao died.
translations.idiomatic: Vice personnel minister Zhang Wenbao died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，清海軍節度使錢元璹加檢校太傅、同平章事；

translations.literal: On gengzi Qinghai Army military commissioner Qian Yuanshan was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor and Associate Counsellor;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Qian Yuanshan of Qinghai was made acting grand tutor and associate counsellor;

sentences.zh: 中吳、建武等軍節度使錢元尞加檢校太師、兼中書令。

translations.literal: Central Wu and Jianwu and other armies military commissioner Qian Yuanliao was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yuanliao of central Wu and Jianwu was made acting grand tutor and secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 以前滑州節度使李讚華遙領虔州節度使。

translations.literal: Former Huazhou military commissioner Li Zanhua was made Qianzhou military commissioner at a distance.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hua commissioner Li Zanhua was named distant Qian commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔天下兵馬大元帥、秦王從榮班宜在宰臣之上。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict: the Grand Marshal of All Forces Under Heaven, Prince of Qin Congrong's court rank should be above the chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict placed Grand Marshal Prince of Qin Congrong's court rank above the chancellors.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Bracket note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：秦王從榮加兼中書令，與宰臣分班左右定位，及為天下兵馬元帥。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Prince of Qin Congrong was advanced to concurrent Director of the Secretariat, forming separate rows left and right with chancellors for positioning, and became Grand Marshal of All Forces Under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials: Prince of Qin Congrong was also made secretariat director, stood in a separate row from chancellors, and became grand marshal of all forces.

sentences.zh: 敕曰：「秦王位隆將相，望重磐維，委任既崇，等威合異，班位宜在宰臣之上。」）〉

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Prince of Qin's rank towers among generals and ministers, his prestige weighs on the state pillar; the commission entrusted is lofty, his dignity and authority should differ; court rank should be above the chancellors.")〉
translations.idiomatic: The edict read: "The prince's rank and commission are exalted; his court rank should stand above the chancellors.")〉

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以北面行營都指揮使、易州刺史楊檀為振武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On renyin northern campaign commander-in-chief and Yizhou prefect Yang Tan was made Zhenwu Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Yang Tan, northern campaign commander and Yizhou prefect, became Zhenwu Army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，以前同州節度使趙在禮為襄州節度使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingwu: former Tongzhou military commissioner Zhao Zaili was made Xiangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the tenth month Zhao Zaili, former Tong commissioner, became Xiang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以前滑州節度使張敬詢卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On dingwei former Huazhou military commissioner Zhang Jingxun died; court audience was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zhang Jingxun, former Hua commissioner, died; court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎任讚為兵部侍郎，充元帥府判官。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Punishments Ren Zan was made Vice Minister of War, filling grand marshal's office adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Zan, vice punishments minister, became vice war minister and adjutant to the grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前鳳翔節度使孫嶽為三司使。

translations.literal: On wuwu former Fengxiang military commissioner Sun Yue was made Three Departments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Sun Yue, former Fengxiang commissioner, became Three Departments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以樞密使範延光為鎮州節度使，以三司使馮贇為樞密使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Commissioner of Military Affairs Fan Yanguang was made Zhenzhou military commissioner; Three Departments commissioner Feng Yun was made Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Fan Yanguang became Zhen commissioner; Feng Yun became military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前潞州節度使李承約為左龍武統軍；

translations.literal: On xinyou former Luzhou military commissioner Li Chengyue was made Left Martial Valiant supreme general;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Li Chengyue, former Lu commissioner, became left martial valiant supreme general;

sentences.zh: 以前威寨軍節度使王景戡為右龍武統軍；

translations.literal: Former Weizhai Army military commissioner Wang Jingzhan was made Right Martial Valiant supreme general;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingzhan, former Weizhai commissioner, right martial valiant supreme general;

sentences.zh: 以左驍衛上將軍安崇阮為左神武統軍；

translations.literal: Left Martial Steed senior general An Chongruan was made Left Divine Martial supreme general;
translations.idiomatic: An Chongruan, left martial steed senior general, left divine martial supreme general;

sentences.zh: 以右監門上將軍高允貞為右神武統軍。

translations.literal: Right Gate Guard senior general Gao Yunzhen was made Right Divine Martial supreme general.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yunzhen, right gate guard senior general, right divine martial supreme general.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以權知夏州事、檢校司空李彝超為夏州節度使、檢校司徒。

translations.literal: On renxu acting Xiazhou regent Acting Director of Works Li Yichao was made Xiazhou military commissioner and Acting Director of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Yichao, acting Xia regent, became Xia commissioner and acting director of works.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔在朝文武臣僚並與加恩，以受冊尊號也。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict granted additional favor to civil and military officials at court, because of receiving the enfeoffment honorific.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict rewarded all court officials for the enfeoffment ceremony.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前安州節度使楊漢章為兗州節度使，以前雲州節度使張敬達為徐州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen former Anzhou military commissioner Yang Hanzhang was made Yanzhou military commissioner; former Yunzhou military commissioner Zhang Jingda was made Xuzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Yang Hanzhang, former An commissioner, became Yan commissioner; Zhang Jingda, former Yun, became Xu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前兗州節度使張延朗為秦州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengwu former Yanzhou military commissioner Zhang Yanlang was made Qinzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhang Yanlang, former Yan commissioner, became Qin commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，秦州節度使劉仲殷移鎮宋州。

translations.literal: On renshen Qinzhou military commissioner Liu Zhongyin transferred to garrison Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Liu Zhongyin of Qin moved to Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，以前滄州節度使盧質為右僕射。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingzi: former Cangzhou military commissioner Lu Zhi was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the eleventh month Lu Zhi, former Cang commissioner, became right vice director.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，改慎州懷化軍為昭化軍，升洮州為保順軍。

translations.literal: On gengchen Shenzhou's Huaihua Army was changed to Zhaohua Army; Taozhou was elevated to Baoshun Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Shen's Huaihua Army became Zhaohua Army and Taozhou was elevated to Baoshun Army.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以保大軍節度使、檢校太尉鮑君福為保順軍節度、洮鄯等州觀察等使；

translations.literal: On xinsi Baoda Army military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor Bao Junfu was made Baoshun Army military commissioner and Taozhou and other prefectures observation commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Bao Junfu of Baoda, acting grand mentor, became Baoshun commissioner and observer of Tao and allied prefectures;

sentences.zh: 以彰義軍節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事杜建徽為昭化軍節度、慎瑞司等州觀察使。

translations.literal: Zhangyi Army military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and Associate Counsellor Du Jianhui was made Zhaohua Army military commissioner and Shen, Rui, and Si and other prefectures observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Du Jianhui of Zhangyi, acting grand mentor and associate counsellor, became Zhaohua commissioner and observer of Shen, Rui, and Si.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以前汴州節度使李從嚴為鄆州節度使，以鄆州節度使李從溫為定州節度使。

translations.literal: On yiyou former Bianzhou military commissioner Li Congyan was made Yanzhou military commissioner; Yanzhou military commissioner Li Congwen was made Dingzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Li Congyan, former Bian commissioner, became Yan commissioner; Li Congwen of Yan became Ding commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，新授右僕射盧質奏：「臣忝除官，合赴省上事，若準舊例，左右僕射上事儀注所費極多，欲從權務簡，隻取尚書丞、郎上事例，止集南省屬僚及兩省官送上，亦不敢輒援往例，有費官用，自量力排比；

translations.literal: On bingxu the newly appointed Right Vice Director Lu Zhi memorialized: "Your servant is shamed to receive office and should go to the ministry to assume duties; if following the old precedent, the protocol expenses for left and right vice directors taking office are extremely many; wishing to follow expedience and simplify, taking only the precedent of vice ministers and bureau directors going to office—only gathering subordinates of the southern ministry and officials of both secretariats to escort—also not daring casually to invoke past precedent with wasteful official expense; self-measuring to arrange;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu new right vice director Lu Zhi asked to take office with a simplified ceremony, citing the cost of full left and right vice director protocols and proposing only the smaller ceremony used for vice ministers, with southern ministry subordinates and secretariat officials escorting him, arranged at his own expense;

sentences.zh: 兼不敢自臣隳廢前規，他時任行舊制。

translations.literal: Also not daring on your servant's account to destroy former regulations; another time may follow the old system.
translations.idiomatic: he would not abolish the old rules permanently and said a future appointee might follow the full precedent.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 戊子，帝不豫。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Mingzong fell ill.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大漸，自廣壽殿移居雍和殿。

translations.literal: On jichou critically ill, he moved from the Broad Longevity Hall to the Yonghe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, gravely ill, he was moved from Broad Longevity Hall to Yonghe Hall.

sentences.zh: 是夜四鼓後，帝自禦榻蹶然而興，顧謂知漏宮女曰：「今夜漏幾何？

translations.literal: That night after the fourth watch the Emperor suddenly rose from the imperial couch and, turning, asked the palace woman who kept the clepsydra: "How many watches tonight?
translations.idiomatic: After the fourth watch that night he suddenly sat up on his couch and asked the water-clock attendant, "What watch is it now?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「四更。

translations.literal: She replied: "The fourth watch.
translations.idiomatic: She answered, "The fourth watch.

sentences.zh: 」因奏曰：「官家省事否？

translations.literal: She then reported: "Has the August One found ease?
translations.idiomatic: She added, "Has Your Majesty rested well?

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「省。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "At ease.
translations.idiomatic: He said, "I have.

sentences.zh: 」因唾出肉片如肺者數片，便溺升餘。

translations.literal: He then spat out several pieces of flesh like lung, and voided more than a sheng of urine.
translations.idiomatic: He then coughed up several lung-like pieces of flesh and passed more than a sheng of urine.

sentences.zh: 六宮皆至，慶躍而奏曰：「官家今日實還魂也。

translations.literal: The six palaces all arrived, exulting and reporting: "The August One has truly returned to life today.
translations.idiomatic: The entire inner palace came, rejoicing, "Your Majesty has truly come back to life today.

sentences.zh: 」已進食一器，侍醫進湯膳。

translations.literal: Food of one vessel had already been brought in; attending physicians brought broth and meals.
translations.idiomatic: One dish of food was brought; physicians served broth and meals.

sentences.zh: 至曙，帝小康。

translations.literal: At dawn the Emperor was slightly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn he was somewhat better.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，天下大元帥、守尚書令、兼侍中、秦王從榮領兵陣於天津橋，內出禁軍拒之。

translations.literal: On renchen Grand Marshal of All Forces Under Heaven, acting Director of the Masters of Writing and concurrent Palace Attendant, Prince of Qin Congrong led troops in formation at the Tianjin Bridge; from within the palace forbidden troops came out to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Grand Marshal Prince of Qin Congrong, acting director of the Masters of Writing and palace attendant, arrayed troops at Tianjin Bridge; palace guards marched out against him.

sentences.zh: 從榮敗奔河南府，遇害。

translations.literal: Congrong was defeated and fled to Henan prefecture, where he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Congrong was defeated, fled to Luoyang prefecture, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，悲駭，幾落禦榻，氣絕而蘇者再，由是不豫有加。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard it he was grieved and horrified, nearly falling from the imperial couch; he stopped breathing and revived twice; hence his illness grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, Mingzong was stricken with grief and horror, nearly fell from his couch, twice stopped breathing and revived, and grew still sicker.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，馮道率百僚見帝於雍和殿，帝雨泣哽噎，曰：「吾家事若此，慚見卿等！

translations.literal: On guisi Feng Dao led the hundred officials to see the Emperor at the Yonghe Hall; the Emperor wept with choked sobs and said: "My family's affairs have come to this—I am ashamed to face you all!
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Feng Dao led officials to Yonghe Hall; Mingzong wept and choked, "My family has come to this—I am ashamed before you!

sentences.zh: 」百僚皆泣下沾襟。

translations.literal: The hundred officials all wept until their lapels were soaked.
translations.idiomatic: All the officials wept until their robes were wet.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜宰臣、樞密使禦衣玉帶，康義誠已下錦帛鞍馬有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu imperial robes and jade belts were granted to chancellors and commissioners of military affairs; below Kang Yicheng, brocade, silk, saddles, and horses in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu chancellors and military commissioners received imperial robes and jade belts; ranks below Kang Yicheng received graded silks, saddles, and horses.

sentences.zh: 遣宣徽使孟漢瓊召宋王於鄴都。

translations.literal: Palace Gate Commissioner Meng Hanqiong was sent to summon the Prince of Song from Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Hanqiong of the palace gate office was sent to summon the Prince of Song from Yedu.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以三司使孫嶽為亂兵所害廢朝。

translations.literal: On yiwei Three Departments commissioner Sun Yue was killed by mutinous soldiers; court audience was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Sun Yue, Three Departments commissioner, was killed by mutinous troops; court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，敕秦王府官屬，除諮議參軍高輦已處斬外，元帥府判官、兵部侍郎任讚配武州，秘書監兼秦王傅劉讚配嵐州，河南少尹劉陟配均州，並為長流百姓，縱逢恩赦，不在放還。

translations.literal: On dingyou an edict on Prince of Qin household staff: apart from advisory aide Gao Nian, already executed, grand marshal's office adjutant and Vice Minister of War Ren Zan was banished to Wuzhou, Director of the Palace Library and concurrent Prince of Qin tutor Liu Zan to Lanzhou, Henan vice intendant Liu Zhi to Junzhou—all as long-banished commoners; even if an amnesty should come, not included in release.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict punished Qin household staff: advisory aide Gao Nian was already executed; adjutant Ren Zan was exiled to Wuzhou; tutor Liu Zan to Lanzhou; Henan vice intendant Liu Zhi to Junzhou—all lifelong exiles never to be released even by amnesty.

sentences.zh: 河南少尹李蕘配石州，河南府判官司徒詡配寧州，秦王友蘇瓚配萊州，記室參軍魚崇遠配慶州，河南府推官王說配隨州，並為長流百姓。

translations.literal: Henan vice intendant Li Rao to Shizhou, Henan prefecture adjutant Sikong Xu to Ningzhou, Prince of Qin companion Su Zan to Laizhou, secretariat recorder Yu Chongyuan to Qingzhou, Henan prefecture investigating officer Wang Yue to Suizhou—all as long-banished commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Li Rao of Henan went to Shizhou; Sikong Xu, Henan adjutant, to Ningzhou; companion Su Zan to Laizhou; recorder Yu Chongyuan to Qingzhou; investigator Wang Yue to Suizhou—all lifelong exiles.

sentences.zh: 河南府推官尹諲，六軍巡官董裔、張九思，河南府巡官張沆、李潮、江文蔚並勒歸田里。

translations.literal: Henan prefecture investigating officer Yin Jin; Six Armies patrol officer Dong Yi and Zhang Jiusi; Henan prefecture patrol officers Zhang Hong, Li Chao, and Jiang Wenwei were all stripped and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jin, Henan investigator; patrol officers Dong Yi and Zhang Jiusi; Zhang Hong, Li Chao, and Jiang Wenwei of Henan patrol—all dismissed to their homes.

sentences.zh: 應長流人並除名。

translations.literal: Those subject to long banishment were all removed from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Long-banished men were all struck from the registers.

sentences.zh: 六軍判官、殿中監王居敏責授復州司馬，六軍推官郭晙責授坊州司戶，並員外置，所在馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: Six Armies adjutant and Palace Director Wang Jumin was demoted to Fuzhou vice prefect; Six Armies investigating officer Guo Jun was demoted to Fangzhou registrar—both supernumerary appointments, dispatched post-haste from their locations.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jumin, Six Armies adjutant and palace director, was demoted to Fuzhou vice prefect; Guo Jun, Six Armies investigator, to Fangzhou registrar—both supernumerary, sent off by express relay.

sentences.zh: 時宰相、樞密使共議任讚等已下罪，馮道等曰：「任讚前在班行，比與從榮無舊，除官未及月餘，便逢此禍。

translations.literal: At the time chancellors and commissioners of military affairs jointly discussed the crimes of Ren Zan and those below; Feng Dao and others said: "Ren Zan was formerly in the court ranks and had no old tie with Congrong; he received office not yet a full month when he met this disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellors and military commissioners then debated punishments for Ren Zan and others; Feng Dao said Ren Zan had no prior tie to Congrong and had held office barely a month.

sentences.zh: 王居敏、司徒詡疾病請假，將近半年，近日之事，計不同謀。

translations.literal: Wang Jumin and Sikong Xu requested leave for illness, nearly half a year; recent affairs, it is reckoned, were not joint plotting.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jumin and Sikong Xu had been on sick leave nearly half a year and were unlikely co-conspirators.

sentences.zh: 從榮所款昵者高輦、劉陟、王說三人，昨從榮稱兵指闕之際，沿路隻與劉陟、高輦並轡耳語，至天津橋南，指日影謂諸判官曰：『明日如今，已誅王居敏矣。

translations.literal: Those Congrong was intimate with were Gao Nian, Liu Zhi, and Wang Yue; yesterday when Congrong raised troops pointing at the palace, along the road he spoke only with Liu Zhi and Gao Nian bridle to bridle; reaching south of the Tianjin Bridge he pointed at the sun's shadow and told the various adjutants: 'Tomorrow at this time Wang Jumin will already have been executed.'
translations.idiomatic: Congrong's intimates were Gao Nian, Liu Zhi, and Wang Yue; during the march he rode alongside Liu Zhi and Gao Nian whispering, and south of Tianjin Bridge pointed at the sun and told adjutants, "By this hour tomorrow Wang Jumin will be dead."

sentences.zh: 』則知其冗泛之徒，不可一例從坐。

translations.literal: Thus one knows that the miscellaneous crowd cannot be punished by a single rule.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous hangers-on should not all be punished alike.

sentences.zh: 」朱宏昭意欲盡誅任讚已下，馮贇力爭之乃已。

translations.literal: Zhu Hongzhao wished to execute Ren Zan and those below to the last man; only Feng Yun's strenuous argument stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao wanted them all executed; only Feng Yun's fierce protest stopped him.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，帝崩於大內之雍和殿，壽六十七。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Emperor died in the Yonghe Hall within the Great Inner, age sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Mingzong died in Yonghe Hall in the inner palace, aged sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，遷梓宮於二儀殿，宋王從厚自鄴都至。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guimao new moon: the coffin was moved to the Two Principles Hall; Prince of Song Conghou arrived from Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon in the twelfth month the coffin was moved to Two Principles Hall and Prince of Song Conghou arrived from Yedu.

sentences.zh: 是日發哀，百僚縞素於位，中書侍郎、平章事劉煦宣遺製，宋王從厚於柩前即皇帝位，服紀以日易月，一如舊制雲。

translations.literal: That day mourning was proclaimed; the hundred civil and military officials in white hemp at their posts; Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Counsellor Liu Xu proclaimed the testamentary decree; Prince of Song Conghou before the coffin assumed the imperial throne; mourning garments counted days for months, as the old rule states.
translations.idiomatic: That day mourning began; officials in white hemp; Liu Xu, vice secretariat director and associate counsellor, read the testament; Conghou took the throne before the coffin; mourning garments counted days as months per old custom.

sentences.zh: 明年四月，太常卿盧文紀上諡議曰聖智仁德欽孝皇帝，廟號明宗，宰臣馮道議請改「聖智仁德」四字，為聖德和武欽孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the following year Grand Minister of Ceremonies Lu Wenji submitted the posthumous title proposal as Sagely, Wise, Benevolent, and Reverent in Filial Piety Emperor; temple name Mingzong; Chancellor Feng Dao proposed changing the four characters "Sagely, Wise, Benevolent" to Sagely, Virtuous, Harmonious, and Martial, Reverent in Filial Piety Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The next fourth month Lu Wenji proposed the posthumous title Sagely, Wise, Benevolent, Reverent in Filial Piety Emperor with temple name Mingzong; Feng Dao asked to change "Sagely, Wise, Benevolent" to Sagely, Virtuous, Harmonious, Martial, Reverent in Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 宰臣劉煦撰諡冊文，宰臣李愚撰哀冊文，是月二十七日葬於徽陵。

translations.literal: Chancellor Liu Xu composed the posthumous-title document; Chancellor Li Yu composed the lament document; on the twenty-seventh day of that month burial was at Huiling.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xu wrote the posthumous-title text; Li Yu the lament; burial at Huiling on the twenty-seventh of that month.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Bracket note

sentences.zh: （《五代史補》：明宗之在位也，一日幸倉場觀納，時主者以車駕親臨，懼得罪，其較量甚輕。

translations.literal: (The 《Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties》: While Mingzong held the throne, one day he visited the granary to observe intake; at the time the person in charge, because the imperial carriage was present, feared punishment and measured very lightly.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties: Once Mingzong visited a granary to watch intake; the steward, fearing blame with the emperor present, measured too lightly.

sentences.zh: 明宗因謂之曰：「且朕自省事以來，倉場給散，動經一二十年未畢，今輕量如此，其後銷折將何以償之？

translations.literal: Mingzong therefore said to him: "Moreover, since I began economizing, granary distribution often takes one or two decades to finish; if the measure is this light, how will later shrinkage and loss be repaid?
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said, "Since I began economizing, granary payouts often run twenty years unfinished; if you measure this lightly, how will later losses be made up?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「竭盡家產，不足則繼之以身命。

translations.literal: He replied: "Exhausting family property, if insufficient then continuing with body and life.
translations.idiomatic: The steward answered, "We would exhaust our families, and if that failed, our lives.

sentences.zh: 」明宗愴然曰：「隻聞百姓養一家，未聞一家養百姓。

translations.literal: Mingzong said sorrowfully: "I have only heard of the people nourishing one family, never of one family nourishing the people.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said sadly, "I have only heard of the people feeding one household, never one household feeding the people.

sentences.zh: 今後每石加二斗耗，以備鼠雀侵蠹，謂之鼠雀耗。

translations.literal: Henceforth for each picul add two dou of wastage, to guard against mouse and sparrow damage and rot—called mouse-and-sparrow wastage.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth two dou per picul were added as mouse-and-sparrow wastage to cover pest damage.

sentences.zh: 」倉糧加耗，自此始也。

translations.literal: Granary grain added wastage began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Added granary wastage began with this.

sentences.zh: 《五代史闕文》：明宗出自邊地，老於戰陳，即位之歲，年已六旬，純厚仁慈，本乎天性。

translations.literal: The 《Lost Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties》: Mingzong came from the frontier, old in battle arrays; in the year he took the throne he was already sixty; pure, thick, benevolent, and kind by nature.
translations.idiomatic: The Lost Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties says Mingzong came from the borderlands, was a veteran of battle, was already sixty when he took the throne, and was by nature sincere, generous, and humane.

sentences.zh: 每夕宮中焚香仰天禱祝云「某蕃人也，遇世亂為眾推戴，事不獲已，願上天早生聖人，與百姓為主。

translations.literal: Each evening in the palace he burned incense and prayed heavenward, saying: "I am a barbarian; encountering worldly chaos I was pushed forward by the multitude—affairs could not be helped; may Heaven soon produce a sage to be lord for the hundred surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Each night in the palace he burned incense and prayed, "I am a barbarian whom turmoil forced onto the throne against my will; may Heaven soon send a sage to rule the people.

sentences.zh: 」故天成、長興間，比歲豐登，中原無事，言於五代，粗為小康。）〉

translations.literal: Therefore between Tiancheng and Changxing, year after year harvests were abundant, the central plain was without incident—in speaking of the Five Dynasties, it was roughly a modest peace.)〉
translations.idiomatic: So through Tiancheng and Changxing harvests were good and the central plain was calm—a modest peace by Five Dynasties standards.)〉

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：明宗戰伐之勳，雖高佐命，潛躍之事，本不經心。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Mingzong's merit in war and campaigning, though high in aiding the mandate, in matters of hidden ascent he originally did not set his mind on them.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Mingzong's battlefield achievements, though great in founding the dynasty, were never what he sought; he had not schemed for the throne.

sentences.zh: 會王室之多艱，屬神器之自至，諒由天讚，匪出人謀。

translations.literal: Meeting the royal house's many hardships, the regalia arriving of itself—surely by heaven's aid, not from human design.
translations.idiomatic: When the house of Tang fell into crisis the throne came to him as if of itself—by heaven's favor, not human plotting.

sentences.zh: 及應運以君臨，能力行於王化，政皆中道，時亦小康，近代已來，亦可宗也。

translations.literal: When he answered the mandate to rule as sovereign, he was able to practice royal transformation; government all hit the middle way, the age also modestly peaceful—in recent generations he may also be honored.
translations.idiomatic: Once enthroned he practiced humane government, kept policy moderate, and brought a modest peace rare in recent times—he deserves remembrance.

sentences.zh: 倘使重誨得房、杜之術，從榮有啟、誦之賢，則宗祧未至於危亡，載祀或期於綿遠矣。

translations.literal: If only An Chonghui had obtained the arts of Fang and Du, and Congrong had the worth of Qi and Song, then the ancestral temple would not have reached danger and ruin, and the years of sacrifice might have been expected to extend far.
translations.idiomatic: Had An Chonghui possessed the counsel of Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui, and Congrong the virtue of Qi Jinggong and Song Jinggong, the dynasty might not have collapsed and its rites might have endured.

sentences.zh: 惜乎！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 君親可輔，臣子非才，遽泯烝嘗，良可深歎矣！

translations.literal: Sovereign and kin could have been aided, but ministers and sons lacked talent; suddenly the ancestral sacrifices were extinguished—truly deeply lamentable!
translations.idiomatic: Ruler and kin were worth supporting, yet his ministers and sons lacked the talent; the ancestral rites were cut short all too soon—a deep lament indeed!
